author: Zephyr I
title: LN-gated ConvLSTM + Attn width ablation: 48 chans (default PG)
abstract: Width ablation for the SOTA LN-gated ConvLSTM with single-head attention pooling under default PG. Sets ConvLSTM channels to 48 to test capacity sensitivity.
